journal_lines: The woodcutter cleared the slope. The miner found what was underneath. Neither would have managed alone.
Roots had grown into the seam. Cut through to reach it. Took both of them.
Timber over ore. Cleared the one to reach the other. Long day, good result.
Felled three trees to reach the rock under them. The rock had been waiting.
The wood made the props. The props held the roof. The roof held while we worked.
Bracing of fresh-cut spruce, fresh-cut spruce in the bag, ore in the bag beside it.
Cleared what the forest had grown over the seam. The forest will grow it again.
Soil to roots to stone, all in a morning. Took something from each layer.
